Hilarious single player plus online and local multiplayer warfare: Worms W.M.D: Mobilize comes locked and loaded with a huge arsenal of Training Missions and Campaign Missions for the solo player. Train up then head online to create havoc in multiplayer modes, with room for up to two players with four worms each on a map!
